title: EOS ValueRange
description: Immutable value object representing one-dimensional numeric interval with one authoritative future Unit Catalog reference.

minValue.description: Optional numeric lower boundary. The schema intentionally defines no engineering minimum.

maxValue.description: Optional numeric upper boundary. The schema intentionally defines no engineering maximum.

unitId.description: Identifier of a future Unit Catalog Entry. The referenced catalog is not implemented by this contract.

lowerInclusive.description: Whether minValue is included in the interval. Meaningful only when minValue exists. If omitted, the semantic default is true.

upperInclusive.description: Whether maxValue is included in the interval. Meaningful only when maxValue exists. If omitted, the semantic default is true.

notes.description: Optional local note. It must not define unit meaning, tolerance, uncertainty, conditions, source evidence, conversion, or display formatting.
